hypotheses: Gossypetin at 10 uM for 24 h in A375 may produce a reproducible histone perturbation, with the strongest anchor feature being H3K27me1K36me2 (standardized -2.366), followed by H3K56me0 (+1.1428) and H3K9me3K14ac0 (-1.0329).

Donors with high anchor similarity to the gossypetin A375 histone profile, such as VU0155056, ruxolitinib, Exifone, KN-93, and Ginkgetin, are more likely to transfer a target-minus-A375 response that preserves the direction and magnitude of the query histone marks.

Because gossypetin is a hexahydroxyflavone with structural similarity to other flavonoids, Exifone and Ginkgetin may share chromatin-modifying or epigenetic effects despite limited direct pharmacological evidence.

The fixed external decoder will select one target cell/feature/sign from the transferred donor responses; donor selection should prioritize those with anchor similarity >0.6 and available histone perturbation data to achieve >0.5 log2 change versus vehicle.
